The '''''Far Seeker''''' was a decrepit [[Luxury liner/Legends|luxury liner]] that ran the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] to the [[Travnin system/Legends|Travnin system]] in the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]] every [[Standard month/Legends|month]].
